newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps may downgrade Unicom's ComEd.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps may downgrade Unicom's ComEd.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said it added Commonwealth Edison Co's fixed-income securities to its watch list for a possible downgrade. The utility is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
It said it took the action Thursday in the wake of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission's placing six of Commonwealth Edison's 12 nuclear units on the NRC Watch List.

Commonwealth Edison's ratings now are as follows: first mortgage bonds and collateralized PCRBs, Triple B; debentures, medium term notes, non-collateralized PCRBs, trust originated preferred securities and preference stock Triple B Minus, and commercial paper D Two.
